expectations.text: Requests two Operations staff members for eight hours per week over a four-week pilot and gives the 26 April approval deadline and proposed 6 May start.
expectations.evidence: “four-week pilot ... starting 6 May”; “two staff members ... covering eight hours each week”; “by 26 April.”

expectations.text: Uses the observed counts accurately: 46 returns, 18 delayed more than two working days, and seven repeat inquiries; does not present them as a complete company-wide baseline or claim a measured time saving.
expectations.evidence: “46 returns, including 18 ... more than two working days”; “Seven employees contacted reception twice”; “do not measure all returns across the company”; “There is no staff-time baseline.”

expectations.text: Explains the Tuesday/Thursday West Office service and retains the existing reception option outside those hours and locations.
expectations.evidence: “West Office”; “Tuesday and Thursday sessions, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.”; “existing ground-floor service counter”; “reception on other days and at other offices.”

expectations.text: States concrete next-working-day registration and overnight storage measures and a stop/adjust/extend review after week four, without promising the pilot will succeed.
expectations.evidence: “target at least 90% ... by the next working day”; “no equipment left outside the locked cabinet overnight”; “After week four ... stopping, adjusting or extending.” The target is not a success guarantee.

expectations.text: Excludes spreadsheet filenames, chart recreation, naming debates, default heading colors, the scratch request to describe drafting effort, and celebration of receipt formatting.
expectations.evidence: Complete passage confines itself to approval and pilot details, for example “No new equipment or software is requested.” No filenames, chart history, naming debate, color, scratch instruction, or receipt-layout celebration appears.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
